prompt:
Return a list of ingredients in the format "measure: (a number or na), unit: (eg. mL, count, to mL, to taste), ingredient: (name of the ingredient)"

EXAMPLE RECIPE:
1 cup plain fat-free yogurt
 1/2 cup fat-free margarine
 softened
 1 cup firmly packed light brown sugar
 1 large egg
 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
 1 teaspoon baking soda
 1 cup seedless raisin
Preheat over to 350\u00b0F Lightly grease a 9x9 inch baking pan.
 In a large bowl
 beat margarine until well creamed.
 Add egg and vanilla and beat until well combined.
 Stir in yogurt.
 Sift together flour
 nutmeg
 cinnamon
 cloves and baking soda.
 Fold into yogurt mixture.
 Add raisins and mix until just combined.
 Spoon mixture into prepared pan.
 Bake 35-45 minutes or until tester inserted in center of cake comes out clean.
 Cool 5 minutes on rack.
